blocks.md: **A heap is a complete tree where every parent beats its children. Root = champion, served instantly.**

steps: PUSH: place at end → bubble UP while beating parent
POP: remove root → move last to root → bubble DOWN swapping bigger child
Both walks touch one root-to-leaf path ⇒ logarithmic

blocks.label: your daily driver
blocks.py:
import heapq
max_pq = []                              # negate to simulate max-heap
heapq.heappush(max_pq, -5); heapq.heappush(max_pq, -9)
print(-max_pq[0])                        # top -> 9
heapq.heappop(max_pq)

min_pq = list((5, 9, 1)); heapq.heapify(min_pq)   # smallest first
